claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes surprisingly easy to apply, even for beginners or people new to false lashes.
Several reviewers praise the strong hold and comfort, including for watery eyes and those who dislike lash glue.
A common complaint is adhesion problems, with lashes lifting or not staying on.
Some reviewers report issues with the liner/glue pens, such as being dry, empty, tacky, or hard to remove.
Some reviewers find the lashes too dramatic, heavy, or thick-banded for their taste.
